profile.hotPath: DOMParser -> jsdom DocumentImpl -> DOMSelector/Finder -> window.addEventListener -> linear duplicate-listener scan
profile.cause: Each parsed XML document installs additional global-window selector event listeners in jsdom. Their accumulating duplicate checks dominate the diagnostic; native browser DOMParser has no such jsdom selector registration.
